narrative: Today's CVE is a second in-the-wild case of the exact root cause the prediction names. The MCP-test endpoints accept a full server config - command, args, and env - and spawn it as an unsandboxed subprocess on the proxy host with no validation. That attacker-supplied tool config running on the host without isolation is now confirmed exploited and KEV-deadlined.
remaining_gap: No MCP host or framework has shipped sandbox-by-default in response; today supplies forcing pressure, not adoption of the isolated-launcher fix.
